60.0.en: Facts would [[justify:justify]] a fair [[outcome:outcome]] and support a [[reasonable:reasonable]] new delivery plan.
60.0.zh: 事实能证明一个公平的结果，也撑得起一份合情合理的新送货安排。

60.1.en: Aunt Mei found a [[suitable:suitable]] hour and asked no [[stern:stern]] [[judge:judge]] to decide the case.
60.1.zh: 梅姨挑了一个合适的钟点，也没请严厉的法官来断这桩案子。

60.2.en: Old [[fury:fury]] melted slowly, and no [[trial:trial]] of anyone was needed to heal the hurt.
60.2.zh: 积压的怒气慢慢化开了，不必审判任何人，这道伤也能愈合。

60.3.en: No one remained a [[suspect:suspect]], and no harsh [[sentence:sentence]] was written on [[paper:paper]].
60.3.zh: 没有人再背着嫌疑，纸上也没有写下任何严厉的判决。

60.4.en: No police came to [[arrest:arrest]] anyone, and no one faced cold [[jail:jail]] bars that [[night:night]].
60.4.zh: 那晚没有警察来抓人，也没有人面对冰冷的牢门。

60.5.en: Their fear of the dark [[prison:prison]] walls faded, and they refused to [[confine:confine]] the talk to [[paper:paper]].
60.5.zh: 他们对漆黑监狱高墙的恐惧渐渐退了，也不肯把话只拘在纸面上。

61.0.en: Aunt Mei would [[oversee:oversee]] morning arrivals and personally [[supervise:supervise]] the milk check each [[dawn:dawn]].
61.0.zh: 梅姨愿意监督早晨的到货，每天黎明亲自督察牛奶的查验。

61.1.en: They agreed to [[restrict:restrict]] [[night:night]] orders and [[restrain:restrain]] loud quarrels before the children.
61.1.zh: 他们约定限制夜间订单，也克制着不在孩子们面前大声争吵。

61.2.en: Both sides would [[commit:commit]] to kindness and hide no darker [[sin:sin]] than the late [[truck:truck]].
61.2.zh: 双方都答应与人为善，除了那辆晚到的卡车，谁也没有更见不得人的罪过。

61.3.en: No real [[crime:crime]] stained the street, and no hidden [[vice:vice]] lived behind the small shop.
61.3.zh: 这条街上没有沾过真正的罪行，小店后面也没藏过什么恶习。

61.4.en: No one offered a dirty [[bribe:bribe]] in the dark, and no one tried to [[rob:rob]] a friend of credit.
61.4.zh: 黑地里没人递过一个肮脏的贿赂，也没人抢过朋友应得的一份功劳。

61.5.en: No [[pirate:pirate]] from a child's paper book came near the [[shelf:shelf]] at [[night:night]], and no helper would [[steal:steal]] coins from the [[jar:jar]].
61.5.zh: 孩子纸片书里的海盗夜里从没靠近过货架，也没有哪个帮工去偷罐子里的硬币。

62.0.en: Talk of [[thief:thieves]] and [[murder:murder]] felt far away from the warm tea and smiles.
62.0.zh: 贼和凶案那样的话题，离这热茶和笑脸远远的。

62.1.en: [[despair:Despair]] never led to [[suicide:suicide]], and no one wished to [[deceive:deceive]] old friends again.
62.1.zh: 绝望到底也没把人逼上绝路，也没有谁愿意再欺骗老朋友。

62.2.en: No shop would [[cheat:cheat]] with watery milk, nor hide any [[quiet:quiet]] [[fraud:fraud]] behind smiles.
62.2.zh: 没有哪家店敢用掺水的牛奶坑人，也没有谁把悄悄的欺诈藏在笑容后面。

62.3.en: No one was called a [[liar:liar]] any more, and no [[bitter:bitter]] [[trap:trap]] waited in the new terms.
62.3.zh: 再没有人被指着骂骗子，新订的条款里也没有埋着害人的圈套。

62.4.en: No [[clever:clever]] [[trick:trick]] was needed, and no one had to [[pretend:pretend]] cheer over warm tea.
62.4.zh: 用不着什么巧妙的花招，也没人必须端着热茶强装欢喜。

62.5.en: No one felt like a [[fool:fool]], and no old [[stigma:stigma]] clung to the driver family.
62.5.zh: 没有人再觉得自己像个傻子，也没有旧日的耻辱标记还缠着司机一家。

63.0.en: The driver decided to [[confess:confess]] the [[delay:delay]] openly and [[conform:conform]] to the new [[dawn:dawn]] rule.
63.0.zh: 司机决定公开承认迟到，遵从那条新的清晨规矩。

63.1.en: Lin was glad to [[reconcile:reconcile]] fully and [[obey:obey]] the shared plan made that evening.
63.1.zh: 老林乐意彻底和好，也遵照那天晚上大家共同定下的计划去做。

63.2.en: Neither side would [[succumb:succumb]] to pride again, nor face any harsh [[penalty:penalty]] thereafter.
63.2.zh: 双方都不再向面子低头，往后也不会再面对任何严厉的处罚。

63.3.en: No heavy [[fine:fine]] was written, and Lin kept no [[mortgage:mortgage]] on the little shop.
63.3.zh: 没有开出一笔沉重的罚金，老林的小店也不曾押出去。

63.4.en: Clear shop [[ownership:ownership]] stayed with Lin, and the handpainted sign kept its simple [[copyright:copyright]].
63.4.zh: 店面的产权清清楚楚归老林，那块手绘招牌也守着它简简单单的版权。

63.5.en: Serving the street was a [[quiet:quiet]] [[privilege:privilege]], and the neighbors would [[accredit:accredit]] him as an honest man.
63.5.zh: 为这条街效劳是一种安静的荣幸，邻居们都认定他是个诚实的人。

64.0.en: A small [[paper:paper]] [[clue:clue]] helped them find better [[access:access]] to fresh farms [[outside:outside]] town.
64.0.zh: 一张小纸条上的线索，帮他们找到了通往城外新鲜农场的更好门路。

64.1.en: No [[anonymous:anonymous]] note spread anger again, and no [[false:false]] rumor entered the shop.
64.1.zh: 再没有匿名的条子煽起怒气，也没有一句假谣言能进这家店的门。

64.2.en: A [[genuine:genuine]] smile returned to Lin's face, and a simple morning [[procedure:procedure]] began each day.
64.2.zh: 真诚的笑容回到了老林脸上，每天清晨也照着一套简单的流程开始。

64.3.en: Daily cleaning became a calm [[routine:routine]], and every kind act brought its own warm [[consequence:consequence]].
64.3.zh: 天天打扫成了安稳的例行事务，每一件善事也自会结出温暖的结果。

64.4.en: No hard [[demand:demand]] replaced kindness, and no sharp [[request:request]] broke the new peace.
64.4.zh: 没有一道强硬的要求取代善意，也没有一桩尖刻的请求打破这份新安宁。

64.5.en: The new rules did not [[require:require]] much money, but asked each family to sign a shared [[petition:petition]].
64.5.zh: 新规矩并不需要花多少钱，只是请每家在一份联名请愿书上签个名。

65.0.en: Aunt Mei did not [[command:command]] like a chief, but would gently [[instruct:instruct]] helpers with stories.
65.0.zh: 梅姨从不像头领那样发号施令，总是用故事轻轻地指点帮工。
